items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: and Sam Rubiwitz, and between sets we would always go up there

ctx.x: And they had this apartment, Mike and Shorty Sherlock

and Sam Rubiwitz, and between sets we would always go up there and we'd smoke a little pot or we'd, you know, and Georgie Auld would be up there every night. And in the meantime Georgie Auld was working with Benny Goodman, and they were looking for a rhythm guitarist, and so I recommended Mike Bryan for the job. Because Georgie used to come down and blow with us every night at Kelly's Stables, you know.

And Mike made the audition and got the job. In the meantime Charlie Christian was the featured guitarist, and consequently Mike and Charlie became very good friends, and Charlie Christian gave Mike an electric guitar, and an amplifier, that Gibson had given him. But they were giving Charlie quite a few guitars at that time so he gave him a new guitar and amplifier and Charlie gave it to Mike. And Mike out of appreciation for my getting him the job gave me the electric -- Charlie's electric guitar and amplifier.…
